segments.text: The hardest skill in money isn't investing. It's getting the goalpost to stop moving.
You hit the number you wanted. And the second you get there, the number moves. More. Just a little more.
That's how people with everything blow it all up chasing more. They never defined enough.
Enough isn't giving up. It's knowing the point where more stops being worth what it costs you.
Define your enough. Honest verdict on the channel.
